transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get our pre-load coordination huddle started. We have three loads ready for movement to the support site during the 0700-1300 window: a clinic cold-chain pallet, a generator replacement pallet, and a routine administrative-supplies pallet. We have Trucks T-1, T-2, and T-3 available. Before I approve any vehicle assignments and loading sequence, I need transportation, maintenance control, and medical logistics to report any current handling or receiving requirements. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, during this morning's vehicle check I confirmed that only Truck T-2 has a functioning refrigerated-power inverter approved for the clinic cold-chain pallet. That equipment note hasn't been added to the movement worksheet yet, but the cold-chain pallet needs to go on T-2.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a maintenance issue before we assign loads. During the current axle inspection, I confirmed that Truck T-3 is limited to 2,500 kilograms, but the generator replacement pallet weighs 3,200 kilograms. That revised limitation is still awaiting entry in the vehicle status board, so it's not reflected anywhere yet. The generator pallet cannot go on T-3.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report the receiving clinic's fixed appointment times. I confirmed with the receiving clinic that the cold-chain pallet is scheduled for 0900, the generator replacement pallet for 1030, and the administrative-supplies pallet for 1200. These appointment times have not yet been cross-referenced with the movement plan, so we need to make sure our vehicle assignments and loading sequence align with them.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Ensure the refrigerated-power inverter capability for T-2 is added to the movement worksheet.
Ensure the revised 2,500 kg weight limitation for T-3 is entered on the vehicle status board.
Ensure the clinic appointment times (0900 cold-chain, 1030 generator, 1200 admin) are cross-referenced with the final movement plan.
